how_these_were_written: What a person types when a window is filling, including the '/clear' and 'lose' phrasings that the description was missing at first. Near-misses borrow the neighbouring skills' vocabulary so the contrast is real. 'summarize this long article' is kept but marked non-lexical: this skill's description has to talk about summarizing, so no honest wording separates the two by word overlap alone. Padding the description to win that case would be gaming the check.

cases.prompt: I am about to clear this session, what do I need to not lose
we are running out of room in this window, what must survive
is this a safe checkpoint to compact
save the handoff somewhere durable before this closes
what are the three things that most need a person to decide
is this repo worth adopting, does it close a measured gap
summarize this long article and keep it short
